Bump version to flyway-13.4.0

Please see the GH release for the release notes

Inherit the operating system proxy configuration in the command line and Docker images, with FLYWAY_USE_SYSTEM_PROXIES=false to opt out. Adds a network troubleshooting documentation page.
Closes #4269: Snowflake parser supports AGENT IF EXISTS clause

Bump version to flyway-13.2.0

Please see the GH release for the release notes

JSON results with timestamps now include a UTC offset. API users relying on getTimestamp or setTimestamp will need to use OffsetDateTime instead
Update BouncyCastle to 1.85
Remove the unused token field from ResolvedEnvironment; database access tokens are supplied through jdbcProperties by a property resolver.
Fix test classes silently excluded from CI by mis-cased and missing @Tag annotations
Provide a way to write configuration to the environment that a scoped configuration targets, since setters write the root flyway block while the matching getters prefer the environment block, and fail rather than inventing an environment when the target is absent. Scoping now merges into a fresh environment model so it cannot clear the resolvers of the model it was given, and clears resolvers consistently however that configuration was scoped.
Overlay resolved connection details onto an environment's existing definition rather than replacing it, so per-environment configuration such as the schema history table and default schema is no longer lost when switching environment.
Remove configuration extension unused by OSS from flyway-core

Bump version to flyway-13.1.0

Please see the GH release for the release notes

Upgraded jansi to use org.jline.jansi package
Accept any case for environments_/flyway_ environment variable prefixes, and document the environments_<name>_<setting> convention.
Add Databricks support to the snapshot-history feature via a dedicated query strategy. Snapshots are stored as Base64-encoded text to work around Databricks JDBC binary-handling limitations, and identifiers escape embedded backticks by doubling them.
Fix Databricks identifier backtick escaping: escape an embedded backtick by doubling it rather than with a backslash, so quoted identifiers containing a backtick produce valid SQL.
Delay the first schema-history lock heartbeat by half the lock timeout. The immediate heartbeat UPDATE was redundant (the lock INSERT already stamps installed_on) and on Databricks/Delta raced the unlock DELETE of the same row, causing a ConcurrentAppendException.

Add CommandExtension.requiresDefaultLocations() so commands like auth that don't use migration locations can opt out of the default SQL location warning, without affecting commands (like add/generate) that need it resolved
